Priya (Product): quick q - can folks post what shipped vs slipped this quarter + who owns follow-ups? trying to assemble the OKR snapshot for execs. TL;DR bullets helpful :pray:

Marco (Eng): Shipped: routing-policy v1 (PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/routing/pull/412) - owners @Marco + @Sofia.
Slipped: autoscale tuning for Dedicated (blocked by perf regressions on 2x sequence workloads). Owner: @Dan.
Next actions: Sofia to open perf triage card, Dan to share repros.

Sofia (Eng): Confirming we shipped the API surface for model pinning. Docs + console changes still pending (assigning to @Priya for doc priorities). :thumbsup:

Li (SRE): Release note: there was a small rollout agradation yesterday; release-bot shows deploy OK for routing-policy v1 but autoscale fix rollback is staged. Command we used: `./deploy --canary=10% --route routing-v1`
Logs: ``
INFO 2025-03-21 14:02:12 - canary start
WARN 2025-03-21 14:03:44 - batch latency spike
ERROR 2025-03-21 14:04:10 - kernel fallback triggered
``

Dan (Platform): Autoscale tuning slipped because the kernel fallback increases latency > SLO on p99 for long sequences. I'm triaging with runtime team; need kernel selection patch (PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/789). @Li can you share the exact test vectors that spike?

Li (SRE): dropping test vectors now in the shared bucket: s3://redwood-ci/perf/long-seq-samples.tar.gz. Also added a script: `tools/repro_long_seq.sh` that reproduces locally.

Alex (QA): Re CRs: Marco/Sofia routing PR needs 1 more review (security + perf). Pinged @Dan for perf review and @Sofia for sec updates. I can run smoke tests once CRs merged.

Priya (Product): Owners for OKR doc: I'll consolidate shipped items (routing-policy v1, model pin API) and slipped items (autoscale tuning). Will call out owners: Marco (routing followups), Dan (autoscale), Sofia (perf triage), Li (deployment/repro), Alex (smoke/regressions), and add timeline asks.

Marco (Eng): Quick asks: @Sofia — can you estimate how long triage takes? if >1 sprint we should propose a rollback plan for Dedicated customers.

Sofia (Eng): Triage first-pass ~3 business days, deep fix depends on kernel patch — estimate 2-3 weeks incl. testing. I'll open an interim mitigation doc and share link by EOD.

Priya (Product): perfect. For the exec snapshot I'll include: shipped list, slipped w/reasons, owners, short ETA, and CR pings outstanding. If anyone has one-line blurbs for impact (cost/latency/customer-facing) drop them here.

Marco (Eng): Impact note for execs: routing-policy v1 reduces tail latency for small-batch interactive by ~15% (measured on Canary). Autoscale regression causes +20% p99 for long-seq workloads — affects Dedicated throughput and could increase cost for customers using long prompts.

Priya (Product): thanks — I'll draft and circulate in #product-docs. If no objections I'll close this thread and fold into the OKR doc by EOD PST. :v:

release-bot: deploy finished for routing-policy v1 at 2025-03-21T14:15:02Z — canary -> 10% -> success.
